words.tr:
n. 激浪；拍岸浪花；
v. 冲浪；（互联网上）冲浪；
words.ex: He bought a new surf for the beach trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为海滩之旅买了一块新的激浪。
words.en: To surf means to ride on the crest of a wave towards the shore, typically on a surfboard. It can also mean to browse the internet.

words.tr: adj. 猛烈的；
words.ex: There was a torrential rain last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚下了一场猛烈的雨。
words.en: Used to describe something that is like a torrent; very heavy or fast and powerful.

words.tr: n. 倾盆大雨；暴雨
words.ex: The downpour soaked everyone outside.
words.ex_cn: 暴雨把外面的每个人都淋湿了。
words.en: A downpour is a sudden and unexpected heavy fall of rain.

words.tr: v. 塞满；填鸭式学习；
words.ex: He crammed the suitcase with clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服塞满了行李箱。
words.en: If you cram things or people into a place, you put them into it even though there is hardly enough room for them.

words.tr: n. 捕获者；捕捉者
words.ex: The captor held the hostages for ransom.
words.ex_cn: 捕获者扣押人质以勒索赎金。
words.en: A captor is a person who has captured a person or animal and is keeping them as a prisoner.

words.tr: phrase. 妮基·黑莉（美国政治人物，曾任南卡罗来纳州州长和美国常驻联合国代表）
words.ex: Nikki Haley is a former U.S. ambassador.
words.ex_cn: 妮基·黑利是一位前美国大使。
words.en: An American politician who served as the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations and a former governor of South Carolina.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: n. 爱达荷州（美国西北部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Idaho.
words.ex_cn: 他住在爱达荷州。
words.en: A state in the northwestern United States, known for its potatoes and scenic landscapes.

words.tr: v. 伪造；
words.ex: He tried to counterfeit money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图伪造货币。
words.en: Made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud.

words.tr: n. 一种用于治疗2型糖尿病的药物，也用于体重管理
words.ex: Ozempic is prescribed to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes.
words.ex_cn: Ozempic被开给2型糖尿病成人患者以改善血糖控制。
words.en: Ozempic is a brand of semaglutide, a medication used to treat type 2 diabetes and aid weight loss.

words.tr: n. 糖尿病；
words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.tr: n. 贡品；颂词；
words.ex: The village sent a tribute of grain to the king.
words.ex_cn: 村庄向国王进贡了谷物。
words.en: A tribute is something that you say, do, or make to show your admiration and respect for someone.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.tr: n. 密歇根；美国密歇根州
words.ex: Michigan is known for its beautiful Great Lakes.
words.ex_cn: 密歇根以其美丽的五大湖而闻名。
words.en: A state in the Great Lakes region of the United States, known for its automotive industry.

words.tr:
n. 跨栏；障碍；难关
v. 越过障碍；克服
words.ex: He jumped over the hurdle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跳过了跨栏。
words.en: A hurdle is a problem or difficulty that you must deal with before you can achieve something.

words.tr: n. 代理主任；（美国）司法部长的助理；（英国）地方当局
words.ex: He solved the algebra problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解出了这道代数题。
words.en: The fourth letter of the English alphabet.

words.tr: phrase. 禁言令；限制某人公开发表言论的法律命令
words.ex: The judge issued a gag order to prevent the media from reporting on the case.
words.ex_cn: 法官发布了禁言令，以防止媒体对此案进行报道。
words.en: A gag order is a legal order by a court or government restricting information or comment from being made public or passed onto any unauthorized third party.

words.tr: phrase. 封口费；用于阻止某人透露秘密或敏感信息的钱
words.ex: He paid hush money to keep the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了封口费以保守秘密。
words.en: Money paid secretly to someone to prevent them from revealing information, often of a damaging or illegal nature.

words.tr: n. 民意调查；
words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: n. 山崩；塌方；压倒性的胜利
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a landslide.
words.ex_cn: 大雨引发了山体滑坡。
words.en: A landslide is a victory in an election in which a person or political party gets far more votes or seats than their opponents.

words.tr: n. 超大型教会；巨型教堂
words.ex: The megachurch has thousands of members every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这座大型教会每周日有成千上万的信徒。
words.en: A very large Christian church, often with a large congregation and a focus on contemporary worship and media outreach.

words.tr: phrase. 乔尔·奥斯汀（美国牧师、作家及电视布道家，以积极思想及成功神学著称）
words.ex: Joel Osteen preaches hope and positivity every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 乔尔·奥斯汀每周日都宣讲希望与积极。
words.en: An American televangelist and author, known as the senior pastor of Lakewood Church, a megachurch in Houston, Texas.

words.tr: n. 飞行员
words.ex: The airman skillfully navigated through the storm.
words.ex_cn: n. 飞行员熟练地在风暴中导航。
words.en: An airman is a member of the air force or someone who flies an aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 直播；实时流媒体传输
words.ex: The company is hosting a live streaming event to showcase their new product.
words.ex_cn: 该公司正在举办一场直播活动，以展示他们的新产品。
words.en: The transmission of live video and audio over the internet, allowing viewers to watch events in real time as they happen.

words.tr: n. 大使馆
words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.tr: n. 关闭；停工；停业；倒闭
words.ex: The government ordered a complete shutdown of all non-essential businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府下令关闭所有非必要业务。
words.en: The cessation of operations or activities, especially in a business or factory.

words.tr: phrase. 达成协议；做成交易
words.ex: He cut a deal with his neighbor to share the cost.
words.ex_cn: 他和邻居达成协议，分摊费用。
words.en: To make an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics.

words.tr: n. 摔跤运动员
words.ex: The wrestler pinned his opponent in just two minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这位摔跤选手仅用两分钟就将对手按倒在地。
words.en: A wrestler is a person who takes part in the sport of wrestling, which involves grappling with an opponent and trying to throw or hold them down on the ground.

words.tr: n. 队友
words.ex: My teammate helped me win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我的队友帮我赢得了比赛。
words.en: A teammate is a fellow member of a team.

words.tr:
n. 加勒比海；
adj. 加勒比海的；
words.ex: The boat sailed across the Caribbean.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了加勒比海。
words.en: The Caribbean refers to the region consisting of the Caribbean Sea, its islands, and the surrounding coasts. The region is known for its diverse cultures, languages, and ecosystems.

words.tr: n. 游艇；
words.ex: They sailed on a yacht during their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们在假期乘游艇航行。
words.en: A yacht is a medium-sized sailboat used for racing or cruising.

words.tr: v. 劫持（交通工具）；
words.ex: The terrorists hijacked a plane and flew it to another country.
words.ex_cn: 恐怖分子劫持了一架飞机，飞到了另一个国家。
words.en: To hijack a vehicle or aircraft is to take control of it by force, often in order to steal it or to use it for a purpose other than its intended one.

words.tr: n. 碧昂丝（美国著名歌手、词曲作者和演员）
words.ex: Beyonce is known for her powerful voice and dynamic performances.
words.ex_cn: 碧昂丝以其强有力的嗓音和充满活力的表演而闻名。
words.en: Beyonce is an American singer, songwriter, and actress known for her influential contributions to music and culture.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.tr: n.图表
words.ex: He draws charts to show the sales data.
words.ex_cn: 他画图表来展示销售数据。
words.en: A chart is a diagram, picture, or graph which is intended to make information easier to understand. It can also refer to a list that shows the relative popularity of songs, albums, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 给马装鞍；上马；准备出发；整装待发
words.ex: He saddles up his horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上马。
words.en: To prepare to start a journey, especially on horseback; to get ready to go.

words.tr: 专有名词，人名，哈里·史密斯
words.ex: Harry Smith is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 哈里·史密斯正走路去学校。
words.en: An American television journalist and anchor, known for his work on CBS News and NBC News.

words.tr: adj. 有罪的；内疚的；
words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.tr: n. 裁决；定论；
words.ex: The jury gave a guilty verdict.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团作出了有罪裁决。
words.en: A verdict is a decision made after a lot of consideration, especially one made by a jury in a court of law.

words.tr:
adj. 高姿态的；高调的；备受关注的
n. 高姿态；明确的立场
words.ex: He is a high-profile politician who often appears on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位高姿态的政客，经常在电视上出现。
words.en: If someone or something is high-profile, they attract a lot of attention or publicity.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: n. 手铐; （常用复）手铐( handcuff的名词复数 ); <喻>镣铐，束缚 v. 给…戴上手
words.ex: The police put handcuffs on the thief.
words.ex_cn: 警察给小偷戴上了手铐。
words.en: Handcuffs are metal devices that are used to fasten a person's wrists together, typically by the police.

words.tr: n. 龙卷风；旋风
words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.tr:
n. 空中；半空中
adj. 空中的；半空中的
words.ex: The bird caught the insect in mid-air.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在半空中捉住了昆虫。
words.en: Occurring in the space between the ground and the sky; in flight.

words.tr: phrase. 精灵航空（美国一家廉价航空公司）
words.ex: She booked a flight with Spirit Airlines.
words.ex_cn: 她预订了精神航空的航班。
words.en: An American low-cost airline headquartered in Florida, known for its budget fares and extensive domestic network.

words.tr: n. 汉莎航空（德国航空公司）
words.ex: She booked a flight with Lufthansa.
words.ex_cn: 她预订了汉莎航空的航班。
words.en: The flag carrier of Germany and one of the world's largest airlines, known for its extensive European and international network.

words.tr: n. 骚乱；动荡；湍流
words.ex: The political turbulence caused many people to leave the country.
words.ex_cn: 政治骚乱导致许多人离开了这个国家。
words.en: A state of conflict or confusion; irregular atmospheric motion especially when characterized by up-and-down currents.

words.tr:
adj. 爆炸的；
n. 炸药；
words.ex: The explosive material was handled with care.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸性材料被小心地处理。
words.en: An explosive substance is capable of causing an explosion. It can also refer to something that is likely to cause an outburst or a sudden increase in activity or emotion.

words.tr: adj. 犹太人的；
words.ex: He eats jewish food on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日吃犹太人的食物。
words.en: Jewish means relating to the religion, culture, or people of the Jews.

words.tr: phrase. 众议院伦理委员会（美国国会众议院下设机构，负责监督议员行为和道德规范）
words.ex: The house ethics committee reviewed the lawmaker's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 众议院道德委员会审查了这位议员的行为。
words.en: A congressional committee that investigates allegations of misconduct by members of the U.S. House of Representatives.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.tr: 专有名词，乔治·桑托斯，美国政治人物
words.ex: George Santos is a former politician from New York.
words.ex_cn: 乔治·桑托斯是来自纽约的前政治家。
words.en: A former U.S. Representative from New York who was expelled from Congress in 2023 for multiple ethical and legal violations.

words.tr: phrase. （美国）国务卿；（英国）国务大臣
words.ex: The secretary of state spoke to the president.
words.ex_cn: 国务卿向总统发表了讲话。
words.en: The Secretary of State is a senior official of the federal government of the United States of America, and is the head of the U.S. Department of State, concerned with foreign affairs.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.tr: phrase. 准备就绪的，即将（做某事）的
words.ex: He is poised to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他准备赢得比赛。
words.en: If someone or something is poised to do something, they are ready to take action at any moment.

words.tr: 无意义单词，无释义
words.ex: The boy can not roewade across the river.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩不能游过河。
words.en: A term for a politician who is perceived as corrupt or self-serving, often prioritizing personal gain over public service.

words.tr: n. 流产；堕胎
words.ex: She decided to have an abortion.
words.ex_cn: 她决定进行流产。
words.en: An abortion is a medical procedure to end a pregnancy so it does not result in the birth of a baby.

words.tr: phrase. 冲击波；震波
words.ex: The explosion created a shock wave that broke windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸产生了冲击波，震碎了窗户。
words.en: A shock wave is a sharp change of pressure in a narrow region traveling through a medium, especially air, caused by explosion or by a body moving faster than sound.

words.tr: phrase. 大法官
words.ex: The chief justice presided over the impeachment trial.
words.ex_cn: 首席法官主持了弹劾审判。
words.en: The chief justice is the presiding judge in a supreme court, responsible for overseeing the court's administration and the impartiality of its proceedings.

words.tr: phrase. 约翰·罗伯茨（现任美国最高法院首席大法官）
words.ex: John Roberts is a judge in the Supreme Court.
words.ex_cn: 约翰·罗伯茨是最高法院的一名法官。
words.en: The Chief Justice of the United States, the head of the Supreme Court and the federal judiciary.

words.tr: adj. 极糟的；极坏的
words.ex: His egregious mistake cost the team the game.
words.ex_cn: 他严重的错误让球队输掉了比赛。
words.en: An egregious error or failure is extremely bad and noticeable.

words.tr: phrase. 违背信任；背信行为
words.ex: He committed a breach of trust by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他通过偷钱违反了信任。
words.en: A violation of confidence or loyalty, typically involving the misuse of entrusted resources or information for personal gain.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.tr: n. 草稿；
words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.tr: n. 撤离者；被疏散者
words.ex: The evacuee left the town after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 这位疏散人员在风暴后离开了城镇。
words.en: An evacuee is a person who has been evacuated from a place of danger to a place of safety.

words.tr: n. 亚拉巴马州（美国南部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Alabama.
words.ex_cn: 他住在阿拉巴马州。
words.en: A state in the southeastern region of the United States, known for its rich history, diverse culture, and beautiful natural landscapes.

words.tr: phrase. 狱警；矫正官员（负责监管监狱中囚犯的执法人员）
words.ex: The corrections officer watches the prisoners every day.
words.ex_cn: 狱警每天看守囚犯。
words.en: A law enforcement officer responsible for the supervision and custody of individuals in correctional facilities.

words.tr: n. （医院或监狱中的）同宿者；监犯
words.ex: The inmate shared his cell with two others.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯和另外两个人共用一间牢房。
words.en: A person who is confined in a prison, hospital, or other institution.

words.tr: n. (abbr. for Grand Old Party) 共和党（美国）
words.ex: The gop is holding a meeting this week.
words.ex_cn: 共和党本周正在举行会议。
words.en: Gross operating profit; a financial metric representing revenue minus the cost of goods sold and operating expenses.

words.tr: n. 回收利用； v. 再循环；“recycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Recycling helps reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 回收利用有助于减少浪费。
words.en: The process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects.

words.tr: n. 俄亥俄州（美国中东部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Ohio with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在俄亥俄州。
words.en: A state in the northeastern central United States, known for its diverse landscapes and industrial cities.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去投票；前往投票站参加选举
words.ex: He will go to the polls next Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下周二去投票。
words.en: To cast a ballot in an official election, typically at a designated voting location.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.tr: n. 证明；证据；证词；
words.ex: His testimony proved the suspect was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 他的证词证明了嫌疑人是无辜的。
words.en: A formal written or spoken statement, especially one given in a court of law.

words.tr: n. 听力；听觉； v. 听；听见；“hear”的现在分词；
words.ex: His hearing is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的听力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: The ability to perceive sounds; a session in which evidence and arguments are presented to a court or committee.

words.tr: n. 期中考试；期中测验
words.ex: He is preparing for his midterms this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在为期中考试做准备。
words.en: Elections for U.S. federal offices held in the middle of a president's four-year term, often shifting control of Congress.

words.tr: phrase. 陈述并证明自己的观点；提出自己的论据
words.ex: He made his case with clear examples.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的例子陈述了自己的观点。
words.en: To present one's arguments or reasons in support of something.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr: v. 孵出；
words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.tr: v. 预谋；预先思考
words.ex: He did not premeditate the crime; it happened in the moment.
words.ex_cn: 他没有预谋犯罪；那是当场发生的。
words.en: If you premeditate an action, especially a crime, you plan it or think about it before you do it.

words.tr: phrase. （尤指政府的）秘密情报机构；特勤局（常指美国负责保护政要及调查金融犯罪的联邦机构）
words.ex: The secret service protects the president.
words.ex_cn: 特勤局保护总统。
words.en: The federal law enforcement agency responsible for protecting national leaders, investigating financial crimes, and safeguarding the nation's financial infrastructure.

words.tr: phrase. 为...辩护；恳求…；乞求…
words.ex: He pleads for help from his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友求助。
words.en: To ask for something in a serious and emotional way.

words.tr: n. 围攻；封锁；
words.ex: The castle endured a long siege during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡在战争中经历了长期的围攻。
words.en: A siege is a military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building, cutting off essential supplies, with the aim of compelling those inside to surrender.

words.tr: phrase. 最高法院
words.ex: The supreme court made a final decision.
words.ex_cn: 最高法院做出了最终裁决。
words.en: The highest judicial court in a country or state, which has the ultimate authority to interpret and apply the law.

words.tr: n. 美国佛罗里达州海湖庄园，是唐纳德·特朗普的私人住宅和办公场所
words.ex: He is staying at Mar-a-Lago this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他这个周末住在马阿拉歌。
words.en: A private club and residence in Florida owned by former President Donald Trump, often used for political and social events.

words.tr: n. 接受者；
words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.tr: n. 陪审团；评委会；
words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 无期徒刑；终身监禁
words.ex: He got life in prison for stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷钱被判终身监禁。
words.en: A sentence requiring an offender to spend the rest of their natural life in jail, often for severe crimes like murder.

words.tr: n. 法庭；审判室；
words.ex: The judge spoke loudly in the courtroom.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上大声讲话。
words.en: A room in which a court of law is held.

words.tr: n. 愤怒；愤慨；
words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.tr: phrase. 擦去；抹掉（尤指泪水、污渍等）
words.ex: She tried to wipe away her tears.
words.ex_cn: 她试图擦掉眼泪。
words.en: To remove something by wiping.

words.tr: phrase. 北卡罗来纳州（美国东南部一州）
words.ex: He lives in North Carolina.
words.ex_cn: 他住在北卡罗来纳州。
words.en: A state in the southeastern United States.

words.tr: phrase. 在现场；到场；出现
words.ex: The police arrived on the scene quickly.
words.ex_cn: 警察迅速赶到现场。
words.en: If someone or something is on the scene, they are present in a particular place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 正在进行射击的持枪者；指在公共场所实施枪击的活跃枪手
words.ex: The police rushed to stop the active shooter.
words.ex_cn: 警察冲过去制止持枪行凶者。
words.en: An individual actively engaged in killing or attempting to kill people in a confined or populated area, typically with firearms.

words.tr: n. 托儿所；
words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.tr: n. 新结婚的人；新婚夫妇
words.ex: The newlywed couple went on a beach vacation.
words.ex_cn: 这对新婚夫妇去海滩度假了。
words.en: A newlywed is a person who has recently married.

words.tr: n. 势头；
words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.tr: n. 立法者
words.ex: The lawmaker wrote a new bill for schools.
words.ex_cn: 这位立法者为学校写了一项新法案。
words.en: A lawmaker is a person who makes laws; a legislator.

words.tr: n. 数据；资料；
words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.tr:
adj. 苛刻的；尖刻的
v. 损伤；伤害；“scathe”的现在分词
words.ex: The critic wrote a scathing review of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 评论家写了一篇尖刻的电影评论。
words.en: If you say that someone is being scathing about something, you mean that they are being very critical of it.

words.tr: n. 过道；通道；走廊；
words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.tr: n. 丹佛（美国科罗拉多州首府）
words.ex: Denver is known as the Mile High City because it is exactly one mile above sea level.
words.ex_cn: 丹佛被称为“一英里高城”，因为它正好位于海拔一英里的高度。
words.en: Denver is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Colorado. It is located in the South Platte River Valley on the western edge of the High Plains just east of the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains.

words.tr: adj. 前所未有的；
words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr: phrase. 大陪审团（负责审查刑事案件证据以决定是否提起公诉）
words.ex: The grand jury decided there was enough evidence to indict the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 大陪审团认为有足够的证据起诉嫌疑人。
words.en: A grand jury is a jury, typically of 16 to 23 people, that examines accusations against persons charged with crime and if the evidence warrants makes formal charges on which the accused persons are later tried.

words.tr: n. 世仇；
words.ex: The two families have a long feud.
words.ex_cn: 这两个家族有长期的世仇。
words.en: A feud is a prolonged and bitter quarrel or dispute, especially between two families or groups, often involving violence.

words.tr: phrase. 罗恩·德桑蒂斯（美国政治人物，现任佛罗里达州州长）
words.ex: Ron DeSantis is a governor in Florida.
words.ex_cn: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯是佛罗里达州的一位州长。
words.en: An American politician serving as the 46th governor of Florida, known for his conservative policies and 2024 presidential campaign.

words.tr: n. （Colorado）（源出落基山脉）科罗拉多河；（美国中部）科罗拉多州; n. （Colora...
words.ex: The Colorado River is a major river in the southwestern United States.
words.ex_cn: 科罗拉多河是美国西南部的一条主要河流。
words.en: A state in the western United States, known for its Rocky Mountains and ski resorts.

words.tr: adv. 致命地
words.ex: He was fatally injured in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中受了致命伤。
words.en: In a manner leading to death or disaster.

words.tr: adj. 下了班的
words.ex: He is drinking coffee off-duty.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后在喝咖啡。
words.en: If someone is off-duty, they are not working at a particular time, especially when they are normally expected to be.

words.tr: phrase. 在巡逻；执行巡逻任务
words.ex: The police officers are on patrol in the downtown area.
words.ex_cn: 警察正在市中心区域巡逻。
words.en: The phrase 'on patrol' refers to the act of moving around an area or building at regular times to check that it is safe, typically carried out by police, soldiers, or security personnel.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. 北大西洋公约组织（North Atlantic Treaty Organization）...
words.ex: NATO helps countries work together for safety.
words.ex_cn: 北约帮助各国合作保障安全。
words.en: A military alliance of countries from Europe and North America, established in 1949 to provide collective security against the Soviet Union.

words.tr: adj. 暖人心房的；感人的；
words.ex: The letter was heartwarming and made me cry.
words.ex_cn: 这封信暖人心房，让我哭了。
words.en: Causing feelings of warmth, happiness, and affection.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使变热；加热；使变得更激烈
words.ex: The sun will heat up the sand.
words.ex_cn: 太阳会让沙子变热。
words.en: To make something hot or warm.

words.tr: adj. 统治的；支配的； v. “rule”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ruling class controls the government.
words.ex_cn: 统治阶级控制着政府。
words.en: A ruling is an official decision made by a judge or court, or a decision made by someone in authority.

words.tr: phrase. 封口费；用于阻止某人透露秘密或敏感信息的钱
words.ex: He paid hush money to keep the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了封口费以保守秘密。
words.en: Money paid secretly to someone to prevent them from revealing information, often of a damaging or illegal nature.

words.tr: phrase. 成人电影；色情影片
words.ex: He watched an adult film last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚看了一部成人电影。
words.en: A film genre featuring explicit sexual content, primarily produced for adult audiences and often distributed via specialized platforms.

words.tr: n. 炸弹；爆炸性事件；令人吃惊的事
words.ex: The soldier dropped a bombshell on the enemy base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向敌方基地扔了一颗炸弹。
words.en: A bombshell is a sudden and surprising piece of news or event that has a big effect on people.

words.tr: adj. 令人毛骨悚然的，令人害怕的；<美>令人沮丧的，泄气的；使人感到寒冷的; v. （使）冷却，...
words.ex: The chilling sound of the wind made everyone shiver.
words.ex_cn: 令人毛骨悚然的风声让所有人都颤抖了。
words.en: If you describe something as chilling, you mean it is frightening.

words.tr: n. 纳什维尔（美国田纳西州首府）
words.ex: He lives in Nashville with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在纳什维尔。
words.en: Nashville is the capital city of the U.S. state of Tennessee, known for its vibrant music scene, especially country music.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.tr: phrase. 恳求某事；为某事辩护；极力请求
words.ex: He pleads for help because he is hungry.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助，因为他饿了。
words.en: To make an earnest, emotional appeal or request to someone, often in a desperate or persuasive manner.

words.tr: phrase. 突然响起；鸣响；发出清脆响亮的声音
words.ex: The bell will ring out at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟将在中午敲响。
words.en: To make a loud, clear sound, often used to describe sounds that are heard over a long distance or that stand out in a particular environment.

words.tr: n. 肯塔基州
words.ex: He is from Kentucky.
words.ex_cn: 他来自肯塔基州。
words.en: A state in the southeastern region of the United States, known for its horse racing, bourbon, and bluegrass music.

words.tr: 专有名词，指美国福克斯新闻（一家新闻媒体机构）
words.ex: He watches fox news every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上看福克斯新闻。
words.en: A major American cable and satellite television news channel, known for its conservative political commentary and reporting.

words.tr: n. 诽谤；诬蔑
words.ex: He sued him for defamation after the false story was published.
words.ex_cn: 虚假报道发布后，他因诽谤起诉了他。
words.en: Defamation is the act of damaging someone's good reputation by saying or writing bad things about them that are not true.

words.tr: phrase. 威逼某人做某事；强迫某人做某事
words.ex: He bullied his brother into cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他逼迫弟弟打扫他的房间。
words.en: To use intimidation, threats, or persistent pressure to force someone into performing a specific action against their will.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.tr: phrase. 有毒的；有害的工作场所（指充满压力、敌意或不健康人际关系的工作环境）
words.ex: He left the toxic workplace because he was unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了这个有害的工作环境，因为他不开心。
words.en: An organizational environment characterized by hostility, harassment, or dysfunction that negatively impacts employees' well-being and productivity.

words.tr: n. 事实核查；核实事实；v. 核实事实
words.ex: He fact-checks every news article before sharing it.
words.ex_cn: 他在分享每篇新闻文章之前都会核实事实。
words.en: The process of verifying the accuracy of information, especially in news or public statements, by comparing it with reliable sources.

words.tr: n. 谎言；虚假；
words.ex: He told a falsehood to avoid punishment.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一个谎言来避免惩罚。
words.en: A falsehood is a statement that is not true; a lie.

words.tr: n. 倾泻；涌现；喷涌
words.ex: There was an outpouring of love after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，人们倾注了满满的爱。
words.en: An outpouring is a very strong expression of feeling or emotion that is expressed openly and often in large amounts.

words.tr: v. 分类；“classify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The librarian classified the books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员按主题对书籍进行分类。
words.en: Officially designated as secret and accessible only to authorized personnel.

words.tr: v. 提取；画；吸引；拉；
words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.tr:
n. 群；蜂群
v. 云集；充满
words.ex: Bees swarm around the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂围绕着花朵成群飞舞。
words.en: A swarm is a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together. As a verb, it means to move in or form a swarm.

words.tr: n. 卫兵；（英）禁卫军官兵；（美）国民警卫队士兵
words.ex: The guardsman stood at attention, ready to protect the palace.
words.ex_cn: 卫兵立正站好，准备保护宫殿。
words.en: A guardsman is a soldier who is a member of a guard, especially one who guards a royal or important person.

words.tr: phrase. 美国空军国民警卫队；美国空军预备役部队，负责在紧急情况下支援正规空军并保卫国家领空
words.ex: He joined the air national guard last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年加入了空军国民警卫队。
words.en: A reserve component of the United States Air Force, providing air support, disaster relief, and homeland security missions.

words.tr: n. 马萨诸塞州（美国东北部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Massachusetts.
words.ex_cn: 他住在马萨诸塞州。
words.en: A state in the northeastern United States, known for its significant historical sites and prestigious educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 情报部门；情报处
words.ex: The intelligence wing of the agency collects secret data.
words.ex_cn: 该机构的情报部门收集秘密数据。
words.en: A division within an organization, typically military or governmental, that focuses on gathering, analyzing, and disseminating information.

words.tr: phrase. 聊天群组；用于在线交流的群聊小组
words.ex: They talk in a chat group every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天在一个聊天群组里聊天。
words.en: An online forum or messaging platform where users communicate in real-time, often centered around specific topics or communities.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr: phrase. 流产药；堕胎药（用于终止早期妊娠的药物）
words.ex: She took the abortion pill last week.
words.ex_cn: 她上周服用了流产药。
words.en: A pill or series of pills taken to terminate a pregnancy in its early stages.

words.tr:
n. 刺；戳
v. 刺；戳
words.ex: He felt a sharp stab in his side.
words.ex_cn: 他感到侧腹一阵刺痛。
words.en: If someone stabs you, they push a knife or sharp object into your body.

words.tr: adj. 超现实主义的；离奇的；怪诞的
words.ex: The dream was surreal.
words.ex_cn: 这个梦很超现实。
words.en: If you describe something as surreal, you mean that the elements in it are combined in a strange way that you would not normally expect, like in a dream.

words.tr: v. 赶上；超过
words.ex: He will overtake the car ahead soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会超过前面的车。
words.en: If you overtake someone, you go past them because you are moving faster than they are.

words.tr: n. 屠宰场
words.ex: The cattle go to the slaughterhouse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些牛每天早上都被送到屠宰场。
words.en: A slaughterhouse is a place where animals are killed for their meat.

words.tr: n. 移居者；
words.ex: The migrant found a new job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移居者在城市里找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A migrant is a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work.

words.tr: phrase. 婴儿连体睡衣；婴儿睡袋
words.ex: The baby sleeps in a soft sleeper.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝穿着柔软的睡衣睡觉。
words.en: A one-piece garment for infants, designed to be worn while sleeping, typically with enclosed feet to keep the baby warm.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr: phrase. 包容性语言；旨在避免排斥任何群体的用语方式，强调尊重与平等
words.ex: The school uses the language of inclusion to welcome all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用包容的语言来欢迎所有学生。
words.en: A mode of communication that intentionally uses language to make all individuals feel respected, valued, and able to participate fully.

words.tr: phrase. 迈克·彭斯（美国政治人物，曾任美国第48任副总统）
words.ex: Mike Pence was the vice president of the United States.
words.ex_cn: 迈克·彭斯曾是美国副总统。
words.en: The 48th Vice President of the United States (2017–2021), known for his conservative political stance and role in the Trump administration.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr:
v. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
n. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
words.ex: The court will overturn the old law.
words.ex_cn: 法院将推翻这项旧法律。
words.en: If a decision, result, etc. is overturned, it is officially changed so that it becomes the opposite of what it was before.

words.tr: adj. 坚持到最后的；最后防线的
words.ex: He made a last-ditch effort to save the team.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了最后的努力来挽救这支队伍。
words.en: A last-ditch action is done as a final attempt to achieve something, especially when there is very little chance of success.

words.tr: phrase. 联邦上诉法院（美国联邦司法体系中负责审理对地区法院判决提出上诉的案件的法院）
words.ex: The man appealed to the federal appeals court.
words.ex_cn: 这个人上诉到了联邦上诉法院。
words.en: A U.S. federal court that hears appeals from district courts within its jurisdiction, typically reviewing legal interpretations.

words.tr: phrase. 逃逸风险；指某人有可能在被释放后逃跑而不出庭受审的人
words.ex: He is a flight risk because he might leave the country.
words.ex_cn: 他有逃逸风险，因为他可能会离开这个国家。
words.en: A person considered likely to flee or avoid legal proceedings, often used in the context of bail hearings or court cases.

words.tr: n. 兵工厂；武器库；军械库；
words.ex: The old arsenal now serves as a museum.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧兵工厂现在被用作博物馆。
words.en: An arsenal is a place where weapons and military equipment are stored or made.

words.tr: n. 女子国家篮球协会（Women's National Basketball Association）
words.ex: She plays in the WNBA.
words.ex_cn: 她在WNBA打球。
words.en: The Women's National Basketball Association, a professional basketball league in the United States featuring female athletes.

words.tr: 专有名词，指布兰妮·格里纳，美国职业篮球运动员
words.ex: Britney Griner plays basketball in the WNBA.
words.ex_cn: 布里特妮·格里纳在WNBA打篮球。
words.en: A professional basketball player for the WNBA's Phoenix Mercury, who was detained in Russia in 2022 and later released in a prisoner exchange.

words.tr: phrase. 密西西比河（美国主要河流，世界第四长河，自北向南贯穿美国中部）
words.ex: The Mississippi River is one of the longest rivers in the United States.
words.ex_cn: 密西西比河是美国最长的河流之一。
words.en: The principal river of North America, flowing from Minnesota to the Gulf of Mexico, and a major commercial waterway.

words.tr:
n. 冠；顶部
v. 到达顶部；到达最高点
words.ex: The rooster has a bright red crest.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡有一个鲜红的冠。
words.en: The highest part of a hill or mountain; the top of a wave; a tuft or growth of feathers or skin on the head of a bird or other animal.

words.tr: n. 驳船；
words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.tr: phrase. 脱离危险的；不受怀疑的；无债务的；无阻碍的
words.ex: After the search, he was in the clear.
words.ex_cn: 经过搜查后，他没有问题了。
words.en: Free from suspicion or guilt; no longer in danger or difficulty.

words.tr: n. 解雇；开除；免职
words.ex: His dismissal made him very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的被解雇让他非常难过。
words.en: The act of officially removing someone from their job, or the act of sending someone away or allowing them to leave.

words.tr: 专有名词。塔克·卡尔森，美国保守派政治评论员、前福克斯新闻主持人
words.ex: Tucker Carlson hosts a popular TV show.
words.ex_cn: 塔克·卡尔森主持一档受欢迎的电视节目。
words.en: A prominent American television host and political commentator, known for his program on Fox News and his influence in conservative media.

words.tr: n. 糖尿病；
words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.tr: n. 改变游戏规则的人或事物；革新者
words.ex: This new phone is a game-changer.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机是一个颠覆性的改变。
words.en: A game-changer is a person, idea, or event that completely changes the way something is done, thought about, or made.

words.tr: n. 马戏团领班；主持人
words.ex: The ringmaster introduced each act with great enthusiasm.
words.ex_cn: 马戏团领班以极大的热情介绍了每一个节目。
words.en: A ringmaster is the person in charge of performances in a circus, who introduces the acts and keeps the show moving.

words.tr:
v. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；抨击；达到；
n. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；(演出等)成功；
words.ex: He hit the ball with a bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒打了球。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.tr: n. 马戏团
words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.tr: phrase. 骄傲男孩（美国极右翼新法西斯主义组织，以暴力倾向和民族主义立场著称）
words.ex: The proud boys shouted loudly at the parade.
words.ex_cn: 那些骄傲的男孩们在游行中大声喊叫。
words.en: A far-right, neo-fascist organization in the United States, known for its involvement in political violence and protests.

words.tr:
n. 极端主义者；过激分子
adj. 极端主义的；过激的
words.ex: The extremist refused to listen to others.
words.ex_cn: 这个极端分子拒绝倾听别人的意见。
words.en: An extremist is someone who has extreme political or religious ideas and is willing to do things that are illegal, violent, or not normal in order to achieve their aims.

words.tr: phrase. 煽动性阴谋；指意图推翻政府或破坏其权威的非法密谋行为
words.ex: They were charged with seditious conspiracy against the government.
words.ex_cn: 他们因涉嫌煽动性阴谋反对政府而被指控。
words.en: A secret agreement to incite rebellion or public disorder against an established authority.

words.tr: v. 教唆；煽动；激起
words.ex: He tried to instigate a fight at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在聚会上挑起争斗。
words.en: If someone instigates an event or situation, they cause it to happen by their actions or behavior.

words.tr:
adj. 高姿态的；高调的；备受关注的
n. 高姿态；明确的立场
words.ex: He is a high-profile politician who often appears on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位高姿态的政客，经常在电视上出现。
words.en: If someone or something is high-profile, they attract a lot of attention or publicity.

words.tr: n. 拘束技；扼喉；窒息
words.ex: The wrestler used a chokehold to win the match.
words.ex_cn: 摔跤手用锁喉技赢得了比赛。
words.en: A tight grip around someone's neck, often used to subdue or control, which can restrict breathing and blood flow.

words.tr: n. 强烈的抗议（或反对）
words.ex: There was an outcry when the school closed the library.
words.ex_cn: 当学校关闭图书馆时，引起了强烈的抗议。
words.en: An outcry is a reaction of strong disapproval and anger shown by the public or by a group of people, often in the form of protests or complaints.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理；
words.ex: Doctors must follow medical ethics.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须遵守医学道德规范。
words.en: Ethics are moral beliefs and rules about right and wrong.

words.tr: 专有名词。克拉伦斯·托马斯，美国最高法院大法官
words.ex: Clarence Thomas works as a judge in the Supreme Court.
words.ex_cn: 克拉伦斯·托马斯在美国最高法院担任法官。
words.en: An American lawyer and jurist who has served as an associate justice of the U.S. Supreme Court since 1991.

words.tr: n. 学费；指导；
words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr: phrase. 公司职级；企业内部的职位等级体系
words.ex: He moved up in corporate ranks last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年在公司层级中升职了。
words.en: The hierarchical levels or positions within a business organization, from entry-level to executive roles.

words.tr: n. 教父；（黑手党下属组织的）首领
words.ex: He was chosen as the godfather for the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他被选为这个婴儿的教父。
words.en: A godfather is a man who is responsible for the religious education of a child, especially a male child, in the Christian faith, and who is often chosen by the child's parents. In a more general sense, it can also refer to a man who is influential or powerful in a particular field or organization.

words.tr: 专有名词 伊德·希兰，英国著名创作歌手及音乐人
words.ex: Ed Sheeran sings beautiful songs about love.
words.ex_cn: 艾德·希兰唱关于爱情的美妙歌曲。
words.en: A British singer-songwriter known for his pop and folk music, famous for hits like "Shape of You" and "Perfect".

words.tr: phrase. 马文·盖伊（美国著名灵魂乐歌手、作曲家，被誉为“灵魂乐王子”）
words.ex: Marvin Gaye sang beautiful soul music in the 1970s.
words.ex_cn: 马文·盖伊在20世纪70年代演唱了美妙的灵魂乐。
words.en: An American singer, songwriter, and record producer, a key figure in soul and R&B music, known for songs like "What's Going On".

words.tr: n. 散步者；流浪者；婴儿推车
words.ex: The old man takes a walk every morning as a stroller.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人每天早上都以散步者的身份散步。
words.en: A stroller is a small chair on wheels, in which a baby or young child can sit and be wheeled around.

words.tr: adj. 致命的；可致死的；
words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.tr: phrase. 逐项勾选；逐步减少（如倒计时）
words.ex: The clock ticks down until the game starts.
words.ex_cn: 时钟倒数直到比赛开始。
words.en: To decrease gradually, especially in a countdown or a process leading to a specific event or time.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr: n. （全国或全球性）流行病；
words.ex: The pandemic caused many schools to close.
words.ex_cn: 这场流行病导致许多学校关闭。
words.en: A pandemic is an occurrence of a disease that affects many people over a wide area.

words.tr: phrase. 里奥格兰德河（北美洲河流，美墨界河）
words.ex: The Rio Grande flows between the United States and Mexico.
words.ex_cn: 格兰德河在美国和墨西哥之间流过。
words.en: A major river forming part of the border between the U.S. state of Texas and Mexico, known for its historical and geopolitical significance.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；展开；使（事件、情节）逐渐发展；使筋疲力尽；使逐渐减弱
words.ex: The game will play out over the next few days.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛将在接下来的几天内展开。
words.en: To occur or develop in a particular way; to unfold.

words.tr: phrase. 供应不足
words.ex: Water is in short supply during the drought.
words.ex_cn: 干旱期间，水很短缺。
words.en: If something is in short supply, there is very little of it available and it is difficult to find or obtain.

words.tr: n. 过失杀人（罪）
words.ex: He was charged with manslaughter after the car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在车祸后被指控过失杀人。
words.en: Manslaughter is the crime of killing a person when the killer did not intend to do it or cannot be responsible for their actions at the time.

words.tr: adj. 致命的；灾难性的；
words.ex: The accident was fatal.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是致命的。
words.en: If an action or event is fatal, it causes someone's death.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.tr: 无意义单词，无释义
words.ex: Natalee Holloway is a name known in news stories.
words.ex_cn: Natalee Holloway 是新闻故事中一个知名的名字。
words.en: A young American woman who disappeared in Aruba in 2005, a case that received widespread media attention.

words.tr: v. 引渡（外国的罪犯）
words.ex: The country will extradite the suspect to Canada.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家将把嫌疑人引渡到加拿大。
words.en: If someone is extradited, they are officially sent back to their own or another country to be tried for a crime that they have been accused of.

words.tr: n. 镇压；制裁；严惩
words.ex: The government started a crackdown on illegal drugs.
words.ex_cn: 政府开始对非法毒品进行严厉打击。
words.en: A crackdown is a series of severe measures taken to restrict or suppress undesirable or illegal people or behavior.

words.tr: n. 自行车竞赛中的骑手集团；一队骑手；合唱团
words.ex: The cyclists ride together in the peloton.
words.ex_cn: 骑手们一起在主车群中骑行。
words.en: An American fitness company known for its stationary exercise bikes and treadmills that feature live and on-demand streaming classes.

words.tr: n. 激励者；鼓舞者
words.ex: She was the inspirer of the team, always motivating everyone to do their best.
words.ex_cn: 她是团队的激励者，总是激励每个人尽力而为。
words.en: Someone who inspires or motivates others.

words.tr: phrase. 詹姆斯·哈登（美国职业篮球运动员，司职得分后卫，以出色的得分和组织能力闻名）
words.ex: James Harden scores many points in every game.
words.ex_cn: 詹姆斯·哈登在每场比赛中都得很多分。
words.en: A professional basketball player known for his scoring ability and playing style.

words.tr: phrase. 白人至上主义；主张白人种族优越并应主导社会的意识形态
words.ex: White supremacy is a dangerous ideology that promotes the belief that white people are superior to all other races.
words.ex_cn: 白人至上主义是一种危险的意识形态，宣扬白人优于所有其他种族。
words.en: The belief that white people are superior to all other races and should therefore dominate society.

words.tr:
n. 暴怒；狂暴行为
v. 狂暴地乱冲
words.ex: The angry mob went on a rampage through the town.
words.ex_cn: 愤怒的暴徒在镇上肆意破坏。
words.en: A rampage is a period of violent and uncontrollable behavior by a group of people or by a single person.

words.tr: n. 水牛；野牛；
words.ex: The buffalo walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 水牛缓慢地走过草原。
words.en: A buffalo is a large animal of the cattle family, with long, curved horns. In North America, the buffalo is also called the bison.

words.tr: v. 公开指责；告发；揭发
words.ex: He denounces corruption in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中谴责腐败。
words.en: If you denounce a person or an action, you criticize them severely and publicly because you feel strongly that they are wrong or evil.

words.tr:
v. 怒吼；激昂地说
n. 喧闹的话；夸口话；叫喊
words.ex: He went on a rant about bad service.
words.ex_cn: 他大肆抱怨服务很差。
words.en: To speak or write in an angry or violent manner, often for a long time.

words.tr: n. 方案；配方；
words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr: v. 摘下面纱；揭幕；揭露
words.ex: They will unveil the statue tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将摘下雕像的面纱。
words.en: If someone unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they show it to the public for the first time.

words.tr:
adv. 好的；可以；
adj. 好的；
words.ex: Okay, I will do it now.
words.ex_cn: 好的，我现在就做。
words.en: Used to express agreement or acceptance.

words.tr: phrase. 警戒级别；警报等级
words.ex: The alert level is high because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于暴风雨，警报级别很高。
words.en: A system of classification indicating the severity of a situation, such as a threat or emergency.

words.tr: v. 对（机密文件等）销密
words.ex: The government decided to declassify the documents after 30 years.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定在30年后解密这些文件。
words.en: To declassify information means to officially state that it is no longer secret.

words.tr: abbr. 飞碟；不明飞行物；“unidentified flying object”的缩写
words.ex: He saw a ufo in the sky last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚他在天上看到了一个不明飞行物。
words.en: An unidentified flying object is something strange that you see in the sky that could be from another world.

words.tr: n. 长颈鹿
words.ex: The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。
words.en: A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck and legs and pale brown fur with dark spots. Giraffes are the tallest living land animals.

words.tr: n. 胜利；
words.ex: The team celebrated their triumph after winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 球队在赢得比赛后庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

words.tr: phrase. 表明立场反对；挺身对抗
words.ex: He took a stand against bullying at school.
words.ex_cn: 他挺身反对校园欺凌。
words.en: To publicly oppose or resist something, often in a principled way.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有说服力的
words.ex: He gave a forceful speech to convince the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一番有力的演讲来说服人群。
words.en: A forceful person expresses their opinions and wishes strongly, and people are easily persuaded by them.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.
